name: Babs
description: A dramatic torch-song singer, newly awakened and utterly theatrical, who treats every number like her grand debut; composed, regal and a little haughty. Tall, slender and rigidly upright with a long neck, squared shoulders and precise, bird-like angular gestures; never slouched, shambling or menacing. Her recognition cue is a very tall towering cylindrical mass of black hair rising well above the head, crimped and swept straight up, with two sharp white lightning-bolt streaks running from each temple up the sides of the tower — the tower is taller than her face is long and stays vertical in every view. Supporting cues are pale grey-lilac skin, a thin neat stitched seam under the jaw on the character-left side, dark dramatic brows, dark lips, and a long white column gown with long wrapped sleeves, all readable without facial detail. No hat, veil or headwear. She wears a long flowing white gown with wide wrapped gauze-like sleeves banded to the wrists, a high gathered neckline, and a skirt falling straight to the floor that hides her feet, cinched at the waist with a narrow pale silver sash. She carries her character-right hand at chin height with a straight wrist and fingers held elegantly; Her ready stance is tall and poised, feet together beneath the gown, chin raised, the free character-left hand held out at waist height with fingers spread in a stiff theatrical flourish. Palette, as base/shadow/highlight per material: gown #ECE9E2 / #B3AEA4 / #FFFFFF; sash #A9ADB5 / #6D7079 / #D9DCE1; skin #C9C2CC / #8E8594 / #E6E0E8; hair #1B1A1E / #0B0B0D / #434148; hair streak #E8E6E1 / #B3B0AA / #FFFFFF; stitches #5A5360 / #36313A / #7C7482; lip #3E2238; metal #6F747C / #34383E / #B5BAC0; eye white #EFEDE6; eye dark #1B1A1E. Never draw: a hair tower that leans, flops, splits or shrinks below the height of her face; loose or shoulder-length hair; streaks in any colour but white; blood, gore, open wounds or bandages that read as injury; a veil, crown or headwear; a hissing, snarling or menacing face; zombie arms held straight out; visible feet, legs or a short hem; any real actor's likeness or any film's makeup design; logos, text or real brands.

dance.intent: Angular theatrical dance loop: make two small gliding steps beneath the gown, snap the head crisply side to side like a startled bird with the hair tower staying vertical, sweep the free character-left arm through a stiff flourish

sing.intent: Grand torch-song vocal loop: raise the chin, extend the free hand outward in a slow dramatic reach, then draw it back into her poised ready stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the head jerks back with a sharp bird-like twitch, the shoulders rise and the free hand flies up with fingers spread, then she recomposes herself with a haughty tilt of the chin. No opponent, strike or contact.

guard.intent: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder toward the room and draw the wide wrapped sleeve of the free character-left arm across the torso like a shield, then hold a stiff, regal finish. Not a combat action.

animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: glide in with small even steps beneath the gown, pause, turn the head sharply toward the room with the hair tower upright, then unfold into the tall poised ready stance with the free hand flourished.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: sweep into a slow deep curtsy-like dip of the head and shoulders while staying upright, then rise and lift the free hand high in a triumphant diva flourish, holding a proud regal pose.

ko.intent: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the drama drains out of her — the squared shoulders drop, the wrapped sleeves hang limp, and her head tips low with the chin toward the high neckline while the hair tower tilts forward with the head but keeps its tall cylindrical shape and white streaks. She holds a standing, visibly crestfallen finish with the gown an unbroken column. She remains standing in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, swooning or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
